# Exact smooth-tangram exceptions

These are all smooth binary tangrams that are not shuffle squares. There
are 34, all of length at most 16.

Let \(R(w)\) denote reversal and \(C(w)\) interchange `1` and `2`. Each
row denotes the full orbit

\[
\{w,R(w),C(w),R(C(w))\}.
\]

Duplicate orbit elements are retained only once. The derivative column
lists \(D(x)\) for the orbit members, with duplicates removed. “Parent”
means the finite-derivative parent in the smooth primitive tree.

| Representative | Full orbit | Size | Height | Derivative parents |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| `1221` | `1221`, `2112` | 2 | 2 | `2` |
| `12122112` | `12122112`, `12211212`, `21122121`, `21211221` | 4 | 4 | `1122`, `2211` |
| `12212112` | `12212112`, `21121221` | 2 | 3 | `2112` |
| `1211211221` | `1211211221`, `1221121121`, `2112212212`, `2122122112` | 4 | 4 | `12122`, `22121` |
| `112122122112` | `112122122112`, `122112112122`, `211221221211`, `221211211221` | 4 | 4 | `2112122`, `2212112` |
| `121122122112` | `121122122112`, `122112112212`, `211221221121`, `212211211221` | 4 | 4 | `122122`, `221221` |
| `122121121221` | `122121121221`, `211212212112` | 2 | 4 | `2112112` |
| `11221211211221` | `11221211211221`, `12211211212211`, `21122122121122`, `22112122122112` | 4 | 5 | `22112122`, `22121122` |
| `1212212211211221` | `1212212211211221`, `1221121122122121`, `2112212211211212`, `2121121122122112` | 4 | 5 | `112122122`, `221221211` |
| `1221121121221221` | `1221121121221221`, `1221221211211221`, `2112112122122112`, `2112212212112112` | 4 | 5 | `212112122`, `221211212` |

The orbit sizes sum to

\[
2+4+2+4+4+4+2+4+4+4=34.
\]

control through length 40. Its canonical SHA-256 is
